mcat_description.short: A Swimming Pool Shed is a prefabricated overhead enclosure or canopy structure built over a swimming pool, typically using a tensile fabric membrane, polycarbonate panels, tempered glass, or FRP on a mild steel, GI, or aluminium frame. Sold as a custom-fabricated, site-installed structure quoted per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Swimming Pool Sheds are architectural overhead enclosure structures designed to cover and protect swimming pools from weather, UV radiation, dust, and debris while enabling year-round pool use. In the Indian market, the dominant commercial forms are tensile fabric membrane structures (PVC-coated polyester or PVDF-coated fabric on MS/GI frames) and polycarbonate panel structures (twin-wall or solid polycarbonate on aluminium or MS frames), with tempered glass and FRP variants also available. These structures are custom-fabricated to pool dimensions and installed on-site, with modular and retractable variants available for flexibility. Primary buyers are hotels, resorts, residential complexes, sports facilities, and schools seeking weather protection, aesthetic enhancement, and extended pool usability.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Swimming Pool Shed' refers primarily to a custom-fabricated overhead enclosure structure built over a swimming pool, with tensile fabric membrane structures (PVC-coated polyester on MS/GI frames) and polycarbonate panel structures being the two dominant commercial forms. Manufacturers are concentrated in Delhi-NCR (particularly Mahipalpur, Bijwasan, Rangpuri), Pune, Ahmedabad, and Hyderabad. The product is sold as a site-installed, custom-dimensioned structure quoted per square foot of covered area. Key material variants include PVC-coated tensile fabric, PVDF-coated fabric, twin-wall polycarbonate, solid polycarbonate, tempered glass, and FRP. Retractable and modular variants are available for premium and flexible-use applications. Primary buyers are hotels, resorts, residential complexes, and sports facilities. The term 'Swimming Pool Shed' is sometimes conflated by buyers with flat pool covers (bubble/solar/PVC tarpaulin covers) — these are a distinct product category with different specifications and buyer intent. Pool equipment rooms (utility sheds housing pumps and filtration) are another distinct product that may be mislabelled under this MCAT.
